observation: The original and corrected native views were compared with the architect’s exterior photograph. The smooth walls are continuous at both wings and at the two-storey right-hand corner. Flush sill shadows, curved ground-floor glazing, the solid projecting balcony and separate thin canopy remain visible. Unmeasured elevations, north-side glazing and the rear openings are estimates.
first_pass_reference: The first image exposed coplanar perpendicular wall ends at the corners and deep sills. The source now mitres both adjoining wall leaves and uses a 90 mm flush sill.
